sentences.text:
Author: D.Ramesh
Bench: D.Ramesh
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice D.Ramesh
 Criminal Petition No. 3376 of 2020
O R D E R:

This criminal petition is filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C. seeking to quash the proceedings in FIR No.708 of 2019 on the file of the Tadepalli Police Station, Guntur Urban, against the petitioners for the offence punishable under Sections 272, 273, 284, 188, 328 IPC and Sections 56, 57(1) and 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Public Prosecutor appearing for respondent-State.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that this Court has allowed Crl.P.Nos.3731 of 2018 &
batch, which arise out of the same crime.
In view of the aforesaid, it is urged that the FIR may be quashed against the petitioners.
Learned Public Prosecutor did not oppose the said submission.

Considering the submissions and in the light of the orders of this Court, the criminal petition is allowed and FIR No.708 of 2019 on the file of the Tadepalli Police Station, Guntur Urban, against the petitioners,

is hereby quashed and consequently no further action is necessary in the facts of the case.
Miscellaneous applications pending if any, shall stand closed.
_________________ JUSTICE D.RAMESH 26th August, 2020 Mjl/* HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE D.RAMESH CRIMINAL PETITION No. 3376 of 2020 ( allowed) 26.08.2020 Mjl/* W P Venkateswarlu vs The State Of Ap on 26 August, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/747890/
